::: {#exr-load-tensor}

#### The digits in PyTorch

Load the digits from [`data/optdigits-test.csv`](data/optdigits-test.csv),
the local copy of the [UCI data](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/80) [@alpaydin1998optdigits] that the course overview uses.
Put their pixels into one PyTorch array that holds each image as an 8 by 8 grid,
and their labels into another.

:::
